release_notes: Added Qibla direction support on Android using the device's current location.
Added a dedicated Qibla Compass screen with live Qibla direction and bearing information.
Added precise device location handling for accurate Qibla calculation.
Added Android location permission handling with localized guidance and recovery options.
Added support for opening Android Location Settings and App Settings when location services or permissions are unavailable.
Added offline Qibla calculation fallback using accurate spherical bearing mathematics when the online Qibla service is unavailable.
Added online Qibla direction retrieval with automatic fallback to local calculation when network access fails.
Added live compass support with heading normalization and smoothing for a more stable Qibla direction experience.
Added robust handling for location permission denial, permanent denial, location services being disabled, and permission recovery.
Improved Qibla location handling to keep device GPS completely independent from the city selected for prayer-time calculations.
Improved prayer-time stability by ensuring Qibla location data never modifies the selected prayer city, calculation method, or prayer schedule.
Added Arabic and English localization for the Qibla feature and location permission guidance.
Improved Qibla calculation accuracy across different geographic regions and coordinate edge cases.
Improved Android background and foreground location handling without requesting background location permission.
Fixed Windows Task Scheduler synchronization and improved regression protection for scheduled Adhan playback.
Improved Adhan notification and playback reliability across Android and Windows.
Improved application version management by making pubspec.yaml the single authoritative source for application version and build number.
Improved release build consistency across Android and Windows.
Improved overall application stability, reliability, and cross-platform prayer experience.
